annotations.title: What are people saying under this video?

description: Use when the user wants to know what viewers raise under a trailer, launch video, ad or review on YouTube, for example whether they talk about price, a feature or a complaint. Returns, for up to eight themes named in advance, the count and share of up to 400 top comments per video (up to five videos) that mention each, with how many comments were read. No comment text. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound.

themes.description: 1-8 words or short phrases to count, comma-separated, e.g. "disc,price,story".

videos.description: 1-5 YouTube video IDs (the 11 characters after v= in the link), comma-separated.
